en.title: First appearance after arrest
en.summary: This is often your first time before a magistrate. The court should tell you the charge, ask if you understand, and may hear bail.
steps: You are brought to court, usually from the police station or a cell.
The charge is read. You should hear what they say you did, in a language you understand.
You are not required to tell your full story today. You can stay silent or say you want a lawyer.
The magistrate may consider bail, remand, or another date.
Ask for an interpreter if English is hard. Ask for Legal Aid if you cannot pay a lawyer.

yo.title: Ìfarahàn àkọ́kọ́ lẹ́yìn mímú
yo.summary: Èyí sábà máa ń jẹ́ ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ tí o wà níwájú magistrate. Ilé-ẹjọ́ yẹ kó sọ ẹ̀sùn náà, kó béèrè bóyá o ye ọ́, kí wọ́n sì lè gbé ọ̀rọ̀ bail wò.
steps: Wọ́n máa gbé ọ wá sílé-ẹjọ́, lẹ́yìn tí o wà lọ́wọ́ ọlọ́pàá tàbí nínú ẹ̀wọ̀n.
Wọ́n máa ka ẹ̀sùn. O yẹ kó gbọ́ ohun tí wọ́n sọ pé o ṣe, ní èdè tí o yé ọ.
Kò pọndandan kó ṣàlàyé gbogbo ìtàn lónìí. O lè dákẹ́, tàbí kó sọ pé o fẹ́ agbẹjọ́rò.
Magistrate lè gbé ọ̀rọ̀ bail wò, kó fi ọ́ pamọ́, tàbí kó fún ọ ní ọjọ́ mìíràn.
Béèrè interpreter tí Gẹ̀ẹ́sì bá ṣòro. Béèrè Legal Aid tí o ò bá lówó fún agbẹjọ́rò.

ha.title: Bayyanar farko bayan kama
ha.summary: Sau da yawa wannan shine karon farko da kake gaban alkali. Kotu ya kamata ta gaya maka tuhuma, ta tambaye ka ko ka gane, kuma tana iya jin batun beli.
steps: Za a kawo ka kotu, galibi daga ofishin 'yan sanda ko gidan yari.
Za a karanta tuhumar. Ya kamata ka ji abin da suke cewa ka yi, a yaren da ka ke fahimta.
Ba lallai ba ne ka ba da cikakken labari yau. Za ka iya yin shiru, ko ka ce kana son lauya.
Alkali na iya yin la'akari da beli, tsarewa, ko wata rana.
Nemi mai fassara idan Turanci ya yi wuya. Nemi Legal Aid idan ba ka da kuɗin lauya.
